text: M55 `nosqcr6z`: the minimal c4s version of `plan-execution` v3 is "the first release with these commands" (`register-home`, `confirm-skill-uses`), "a package constant set from the code". No published c4s release carries them yet: `package.json` reads 2.1.64 and the CHANGELOG's last entry is [2.1.64] (2.1.65–2.1.66 were implemented but not published). Assumed: the package version follows the specification release it implements, as 2.1.64 did, so the first release with the commands is 2.1.67 — `PLAN_EXECUTION_MIN_C4S_VERSION = '2.1.67'`. If the next publish carries another number, the constant must follow it.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-6707 — the first c4s release carrying the registry commands is numbered 2.1.67.
